newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't considers lowering telcom rates - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't considers lowering telcom rates - paper.

text.p: Brazil's government is considering the possibility of lowering telecommunications rates, Communications Minister Sergio Motta was quoted as saying.
O Globo newspaper said Motta denied state telecom firm Telebras is requesting rate increases.
"At the moment, things are stable. We are thinking about deflation, not about an increase in rates. Currently, we hope to lower prices," Motta was quoted as saying.
The report was unclear about what kind of telephone rates Motta was referring to.
No officials from the Communications Ministry were immediately available to confirm the report.
